_comment: Single source of every brand string in the Mainfast suite. Edit here, then run `npm run brand:sync` at the suite root: it rewrites each package's action.yml, package.json, plugin.json and example workflows. TypeScript reads this file directly through @mainfast/shared/brand. Prose (README.md, docs/, SKILL.md) is not rewritten: grep for the old value after a rename. `npm run brand:check` (and test/brand.test.ts) fails when a generated file drifts.

plan._benefitIds: Polar licence-key benefit id of each plan: a key whose benefit_id is `pro` is Mainfast Pro; `free` is the optional free key (registered user, not Pro).

polar._comment: Licence keys are checked with Polar's public customer-portal endpoint POST {api}/v1/customer-portal/license-keys/validate {key, organization_id}: no merchant secret. These are the live Polar values. While organizationId is all zeros no key is sent anywhere. apiEnv / orgEnv override both, e.g. the sandbox.

intact.tagline: prove merge commits did not silently drop changes from main
intact.description: Prove merge commits did not silently drop changes from main (dropped hunks, evil merges).

plugin.name: mainfast
plugin.description: Mainfast Intact: check merge commits for dropped main changes before you push.

migrations.description: Fails a PR whose database migrations would fork the migration history once merged into main (Alembic, Django, Prisma, Rails, Flyway, Drizzle), and re-checks open PRs with a blocking commit status when main moves.

rollcall.description: Audits required status checks (branch protection and rulesets) against what recent merged and open PRs actually reported — never-ran, skipped-as-success, renamed, path-filtered, merged while pending, drift — and keeps one tracking issue open while something is wrong.

owners.description: CODEOWNERS drift — unowned files a PR touches, owners who left the org or lost write access, missing teams, dead patterns, dormant owners.

evidence.tagline: proof, not review, for pull requests written by coding agents
evidence.description: Proof, not review, for pull requests written by coding agents. Posts an evidence card per head commit.
